selection_firewall.candidate_origin: MC01 class-gap search by exact host-guest association identity and independent kinetic/PMF availability before any residual, chi, or ChemSA calculation

theory_source.authors: Wanli You; Zhiye Tang; Chia-en A. Chang
theory_source.title: Potential Mean Force from Umbrella Sampling Simulations: What Can We Learn and What Is Missed?
theory_source.journal: Journal of Chemical Theory and Computation
theory_source.method: umbrella sampling in AMBER14 with explicit TIP3P water; beta-CD/guest COM distance reaction coordinate; 260 windows at 0.1 A spacing; 2.5 ns production per window at 298 K; PMF reconstructed with WHAM/MBAR
theory_source.method_selection_provenance: Three beta-CD conformations were selected as high-population/low-computed-free-energy structures from prior simulations. The paper states conf1 and conf2 PMFs are highly similar and therefore discusses conf1 in detail. No conformation or force-field variant is selected here by the observed association-rate residual.

barrier_quantity.type: finite-temperature potential-of-mean-force association barrier for the conf1 host conformation with the two cavity-direction paths represented in the PMF
barrier_quantity.conformational_dependence: The source explicitly demonstrates that beta-CD conformation alters absolute PMF heights; conf1 and conf2 are similar but conf3 differs.
barrier_quantity.artifact_exclusion: The source identifies the PMF barrier at the reaction-coordinate origin as a restraint artifact and instructs that it be ignored; the 1.1 kcal/mol association barrier is the physically interpreted outer association barrier, not the origin artifact.

primary_1997.author: Sadakatsu Nishikawa
primary_1997.title: Kinetics of Complexation between Cyclodextrin and Alcohol by Ultrasonic Relaxation Method: beta-Cyclodextrin Solutions with 1-Butanol and 2-Methyl-2-propanol
primary_1997.journal: Bulletin of the Chemical Society of Japan
primary_1997.primary_abstract_evidence: Aqueous beta-CD/1-butanol at 25 C; a single relaxation is assigned to host-guest complexation; rate and equilibrium constants were determined from concentration dependence of relaxation frequency.

primary_series_2001.authors: Sadakatsu Nishikawa; Takaho Ugawa; Takanori Fukahori
primary_series_2001.title: Molecular Recognition Kinetics of beta-Cyclodextrin for Several Alcohols by Ultrasonic Relaxation Method
primary_series_2001.role: primary experimental series and explicit comparison to previously measured beta-CD/alcohol systems

author_repository_table.title: Molecular Recognition Kinetics
author_repository_table.author: Takanori Fukahori
author_repository_table.role: author-lineage archival numerical transcription of beta-CD/nor-butanol kinetic constants at 25 C

observed_comparator.numeric_provenance_note: The exact beta-CD/nor-butanol constants are reproduced in Table 5 of the Saga University author-lineage thesis and in later peer-reviewed experimental-comparison tables; the 1997 primary journal record independently confirms that this exact system was measured at 25 C and that rate constants were obtained from concentration-dependent ultrasonic relaxation.

condition_mapping.phase: MATCHED aqueous explicit-water theory versus aqueous experiment
condition_mapping.event: MATCHED bimolecular host-guest association; experimental k_on compared with the association-side PMF barrier
condition_mapping.standard_state: The experimental comparator retains its M^-1 s^-1 concentration convention; the PMF value is not relabelled as a standard-state activation free energy.

independence_basis: The kinetic measurements predate the 2019 umbrella-sampling study by roughly two decades and come from an independent experimental group.
The theory study tests PMF sensitivity to conformation/path construction and does not fit the conf1 PMF to the beta-CD/1-butanol association rate.
The paper explicitly reports an ordering imperfection between aspirin and 1-butanol association barriers, which is inconsistent with selecting the PMF to force rate agreement.
No residual, chi value, expected ChemSA agreement, rate-derived activation quantity, or post hoc force-field choice is allowed to vote on promotion.
representation_basis: The 1.1 kcal/mol quantity is retained only for conf1 and may not be treated as the unique beta-CD/1-butanol barrier. The source contains two cavity-direction paths and demonstrates host-conformation dependence, so adjudication must preserve that structure.
quarantined_evidence: Computed/experimental agreement in binding affinity is not a selection or promotion vote.
Relative agreement of computed barrier ordering with experimental rates is not a selection or promotion vote.
The 1.1 kcal/mol conf1 PMF barrier may not be promoted to a universal single-barrier coordinate without separate adjudication of conformational/path representation.
